Dear Cedar Utilities,

Thank you for your quote for the check-out works at Flat 21, 11 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ7 0ZZ (ref R/PM006-2): replacing the burnt carpet and repainting throughout.

The itemised figures and any photos did not come through to our records. Please could you send the quote again as an attachment, with the cost of each item, the total (saying whether VAT is included), photos and how long the work will take?

When we have it, we will send it to the landlord for approval. Please do not start any work until we confirm in writing that it is approved.

The previous tenant has moved out, so please don't contact them. If you need access, please contact us.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
